findings.text: Deterministic cache descriptor for one cache level. First output word encodes category and topology: kind of cache, numeric level, self initialization and fully associative properties, plus counts of sharing threads and package cores. Second word encodes geometry: coherency line size, partition count and associativity ways. Third word encodes set count. Fourth word encodes hierarchy behavior such as remote lower level invalidation guarantees, inclusivity and indexing complexity.
Valid subleaf index span for the deterministic cache descriptor starts at zero and ends at thirty one inclusive.

Monitor and wait capability descriptor. First two output words give smallest and largest monitor line sizes in bytes. Third word reports extension availability and whether interrupts break waits. Fourth word reports per C state sub state counts from C0 through C7, each in a small numeric field.

Thermal, power and hardware managed performance descriptor. First word is a wide set of presence flags for sensors, boost modes, always running timer behavior, notification events, package management, many hardware P state and duty cycling options, feedback and director support, plus related control interfaces. Second word gives thermometer threshold count. Third word covers frequency and bias interfaces and director class count. Fourth word covers capability reporting, feedback structure sizing in page units, and the current logical processor feedback index.

Main structured feature enumeration for base subleaf. First word is a count of available subleaves. Remaining three words are dense single bit presence indicators for instruction extensions, memory protections, virtualization and tracing helpers, transactional memory, vector and cryptographic extensions, key and bus controls, and speculation and core capability reporting interfaces. Representative members include supervisor protection controls, vector extensions, protection keys, and speculation control reporting.

Extended feature enumeration for subleaf one. First word reports newer vector, address separation, compare add, flexible return, load GS, non serializing store, interrupt source, matrix and masking capabilities, plus list based MSR access and fast string operation variants. Second word reports protected inventory support. Third word is entirely reserved. Fourth word reports further vector neural, convert, complex tile, prefetch and shadow stack safety capabilities.

Mitigation control enumeration for subleaf two. First three output words are entirely reserved. Final word carries single bit indicators for store forwarding disable, indirect prediction and return safety controls, data dependent prefetch and branch history controls, mitigation need reporting, and microcode lock disable.

Direct cache access descriptor. Only one presence bit is defined in the first output word to indicate firmware enablement. All other bits in all four words are reserved and carry no defined meaning in this fragment.

Performance monitoring version descriptor. First word gives version identifier, per processor general counter count and width, and event mask length. Second word is an unavailability bitmap where set means a specific architectural event or top down category is absent. Third word is a fixed counter support bitmap. Fourth word gives fixed counter count and width plus deprecation reporting for any thread mode.

Extended topology enumeration for one domain level. First word gives shift width covering this and lower levels. Second word gives logical processor count across all instances of the domain. Third word distinguishes domain number and domain kind. Fourth word gives the current logical processor extended APIC identifier.
Valid subleaf index span for the extended topology descriptor starts at zero and ends at one inclusive.

Extended state enumeration base descriptor. First word is a feature presence map for user state components managed through the main control register, covering legacy floating and vector state, bound and protection key state, mask and tile state, and control flow state. Second and third words give save area sizes for currently enabled features and for all supported features. Fourth word is largely reserved apart from a platform specific profiling indicator.

Extended state instruction and supervisor capability descriptor. First word indicates availability of optimized, compacted and supervisor save and restore operations, stepped access, and extended disable. Second word gives combined save area size for enabled user plus supervisor features. Third word maps supervisor only component presence such as trace, PASID, control flow, duty cycling, user interrupt, branch record and hardware P state components. Fourth word is reserved.

Per component extended state size descriptor. First word gives component save area size in bytes. Second word gives byte offset of that component area. Third word distinguishes supervisor versus user components and reports compacted alignment behavior. Fourth word is reserved.
Valid per component subleaf index span for extended state starts at two and ends at sixty three inclusive.

Quality of service monitoring base descriptor. First and third words are reserved. Second word gives maximum resource identifier within the core using zero based encoding. Fourth word carries a presence indicator for last level cache monitoring.

Last level cache monitoring capability descriptor. First word encodes counter width behavior, overflow bit location, and presence of non processor agents supporting cache and bandwidth monitoring. Second word gives conversion factor from counter units to bytes. Third word gives maximum monitoring identifier. Fourth word indicates which monitoring event kinds are supported: occupancy, total bandwidth and local bandwidth.

Quality enforcement base descriptor. Only the second output word carries defined presence bits for last level cache allocation, second level allocation, and bandwidth allocation. All other words are reserved.

Cache allocation capability descriptor for one resource kind. First word encodes capacity mask length. Second word is an allocation unit bitmap. Third word reports update frequency guidance and support for code data prioritization and sparse masks. Fourth word gives maximum service class using zero based style bounds.

Bandwidth allocation capability descriptor. First word encodes maximum throttling value. Second word is reserved. Third word reports per thread control availability and whether delay values behave linearly. Fourth word gives maximum service class.
Valid resource subleaf index span for cache allocation starts at one and ends at two inclusive, while bandwidth allocation uses subleaf three.

Secure enclave base capability descriptor. First word indicates supported enclave versions and available privileged and unprivileged enclave operations. Second word indicates which miscellaneous state reporting options are available for asynchronous exits. Third word is reserved. Fourth word gives maximum enclave sizes for non 64 bit and 64 bit modes in logarithmic form.

Enclave attribute descriptor. First word encodes allowed security control attributes such as initialization, debug permission, mode, key derivation options, control flow and sharing behavior, and asynchronous notification support. Second word is reserved. Third word encodes allowed extended feature set inside enclaves, parallel to floating, vector, bound, mask, key and tile components. Fourth word is reserved.

Enclave page cache section descriptor for one section. Fields are split across words to form a wide base address and a wide size, each with low and high parts, plus a small section kind encoding and a small type encoding. Unused bit ranges are reserved.
Valid per section subleaf index span for enclave page cache enumeration starts at two and ends at thirty one inclusive.

Processor trace base capability descriptor. First word gives maximum supported subleaf. Second word is a set of feature presence bits for filtering, timing, write, power and event tracing, and packet control options. Third word reports supported output schemes including table based, single range and transport outputs, plus address payload semantics. Fourth word is reserved.

Processor trace configuration descriptor. First word gives configurable address range count and a bitmap of supported timing periods. Second word gives bitmaps of supported cycle thresholds and status periods. Remaining words are reserved.

Each descriptor is four 32 bit output words with named bit partitions; unnamed partitions are reserved and must be treated as undefined rather than as feature indicators. A set single bit means the associated capability is present, while for the performance unavailability map a set bit means the event is absent.

Several numeric fields use biased encodings rather than direct values: some geometry and identifier maxima are zero based, some mask lengths and throttle maxima use minus one notation, line and state sizes are in bytes, enclave maxima are base two logarithms, and feedback sizing is in 4K page units with conversion factors where defined.
